festivals.what: Festival Folclórico de Parintins: the boi-bumbá contest between Caprichoso and Garantido at the Bumbódromo in Parintins, held in late June with Amazonas state backing. The 2026 (59th) edition ran 26 to 28 June. The state has announced a new Bumbódromo to be built over about three years without stopping the festival. 2027 dates not yet announced.

sources.title: Governo do Amazonas lança Festival de Parintins 2026 e apresenta novo Bumbódromo (state news reproduced in a CETAM publication)
